05 / A little about meThe person behind the pixels.

HI, I'M CHITRAKSH.

Curious by nature.
Building by choice.

I hail from Mumbai — a city that never really stands still — and that energy reflects the way I like to learn: stay curious, try things for myself, and keep moving forward. I'm currently pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE Core) at VIT Vellore, where I'm exploring how ideas can become useful, thoughtfully built technology.

I'm a technology enthusiast and an early-stage builder. I created an Expense Calculator App using Flutter and Dart, and I'm especially interested in the possibilities of AI and machine learning. But I don't see myself as just a person who codes: leadership as Junior Head Boy, Model United Nations, research on mental health and the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and hosting school events have all shaped how I communicate and work with people.

When I'm away from a screen full of code, I enjoy gaming, basketball, drama, public speaking, and discovering new technology. I'm still learning, still experimenting, and interested in the space where technology, creativity, and real-world problems meet.

PROJECT 001 / FLUTTER

Expense
Calculator.

A Flutter + Dart mobile app built as a practical exploration of app structure, interface design and programming fundamentals. Simple problem. Real software.

Flutter SDKDartMobile UIProduct thinking
THE INTENT

Make everyday expense tracking feel approachable and easy to scan.

THE APPROACH

Use Flutter and Dart to explore a mobile interface, organise spending categories and present totals clearly.

NEXT ITERATION

With further development, the next step is to validate the experience with real users and refine features based on feedback.

A / SELECTED ACHIEVEMENT

Aditya Birla Fashion Industry

Among approximately 50,000 students, I was selected into the top 25 in the Aditya Birla Fashion Industry competition/internship process. The experience brought together competitive selection, creativity and an interest in how industries work.

B / RESEARCH & IMPACT

National-level research recognition

Earned national-level recognition for a research paper exploring mental health through the lens of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The work reflects my interest in connecting research with issues that matter to people.

C / LEADERSHIP

Junior Head Boy

Chosen through an interview process for a student leadership role, developing responsibility, communication and the habit of leading by example.

Took part as a Model United Nations speaker, researching issues, shaping arguments and presenting ideas in a formal forum — experience that complements my technical interests with communication and perspective.
